item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs mdel kha gsang ba'i tan+t+ra las nang gtor ma'i bskang ba
item.coloph: dbal gshen stag la me 'bar gyi phyag len/ lha klu mi gsum gyi thugs bcud/ nam mkha' snang ba mdog can gyis mdor bsdus/ lho yi gshen gsum la brgyad pa'o/ des zhang zhung gshen gsum la brgyud/ des rgya bod gshen gsum la brgyud/ des phrom bod zhang zhung gshen gsum la brgyud/ des se lde mi gsum la brgyud/ des dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud do/ des dmu tsha gyer med la brgyud/ des blo ldan snying po la brgyud/ de yi mdun du sgo rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyis zhus/ de la bdag tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa'o//
